tweets.text:
AI models are inevitably going to keep getting better and better at all coding, tool and computer use, math, and other coding-related tasks. As a result, agents that can use software to do their work, or generate code from scratch, will improve at a faster rate than all other domains of knowledge work.

On one hand that could mean that only a small subset of work can get automated. But probably what happens is that more and more work just becomes coding-shaped to adapt to what agents are good at.

You can see it in the most recent examples of model releases in the past couple of months, where agents can generate code that becomes animated videos, games, 3D models for products, and so on. We also know that tool use gives agents the ability to work with much of the same software that people already work with. This helps in cyber, life sciences, finance, and a number of other domains.

Our mental model traditionally has been that the models have to be able to know everything about anything to generate value, but in reality they *really* have to know how to use or generate software effectively combined with deep domain expertise to make the right judgment calls inside of workflows. 

When you have that powerful combination, almost everything else gets unlocked. This is why the acceleration of agents in knowledge work is only going to increase from here.

Elon makes a really good point. Jensen is the face of Nvidia. It’s the same way people believed in Tesla and SpaceX because of Elon, or stuck with Berkshire because of Buffett. Sometimes you’re betting on the person as much as the company.

There’s a story from Nvidia’s early days that shows it. In the mid 90s Nvidia was building a chip for a Sega console, and it turned out to be the wrong tech. Nvidia had about a month of cash left. Jensen could have hidden it or tried to ship something broken. Instead he flew to Japan and told Sega straight up that the project was dead. Then he asked them to turn the last $5 million they owed under the contract into an investment, and he warned them the money would probably be lost.

Sega’s exec Irimajiri trusted him, talked his board into it, and that $5 million kept Nvidia alive long enough to build the RIVA 128, which is the chip that got them going. Jensen still thanks him for it 30 years later.

Honesty and relationships saved the company, and that’s hard to replace.

tweets.text:
I have been investing in the crypto industry for more than a decade.

Here is what you need to remember in moments like this:

1. There is always a reason the price is going up or down, even if you don’t know what the reason is right now.

2. You are never as smart as you feel in bull markets and you are never as dumb as you feel in bear markets.

3. Bitcoin’s price can always go lower before it recovers.

4. Dollar cost averaging over time is a much better strategy for most people than trying to trade volatile moves.

5. Buying bitcoin when the Fear & Greed Index is under 20 has historically been attractive.

6. Bitcoin is not the same asset it used to be. Things like interest rates, AI stocks, etc are part of the game now.

7. You shouldn’t put all of your money in a single asset, including bitcoin, regardless of how bullish you are.

8. You can’t eat your bitcoin or sleep in it, so make sure you keep money for the “real world” needs.

9. People who don’t obsess over the bitcoin price every day are more likely to hold long-term.

10. The government will never stop printing money, which is bitcoin’s strongest long-term argument in my opinion.

11. The media loves to claim bitcoin is dying. They have done it hundreds of times and they have been wrong every time.

12. The critics get the loudest when bitcoin’s price falls. The louder they screech, the more attractive bitcoin probably is.

13. Bitcoin’s hash rate is an important metric to pay attention to and it has been increasing the network security recently.

14. As AI abundance becomes more pervasive in society, bitcoin’s scarcity will likely become more valuable.

15. The best psychological hack I ever discovered is to promise myself that I was going to give any bitcoin to my grandchildren. This way I am never tempted to make emotional decisions.

16. Modern bitcoin volatility is small compared to what early bitcoiners went through.

17. While it can be hard on day’s like today, try to have fun and remember that weathering negative volatility is the price of capturing the upside return in the long-run. 

I hope this helps a few people. Let me know what I missed.

Jensen Huang should have known even a pawn can take down a king. 

I have been obsessed with learning about business and investing since I was a young kid. I would voraciously read books and articles about the world’s most successful founders, executives, and investors. I wanted to understand how they built their fortunes and I was motivated by their stories.

Author @JackCarrUSA highlighted a pattern I kept noticing: Even a pawn can take down a king.

It is no secret that wealthy, powerful people are in constant competition with each other. They are trying to find asymmetric opportunities and exploit them for their own gain. Business is a giant game of risk-taking played by some of the smartest, most ruthless people in the world.

But it is rarely a competitor who takes down one of the world’s richest or most powerful people.

Take famed investor Kirk Kerkorian as an example. He spent decades building his holding company into a global powerhouse. His generational run created over $16 billion of personal wealth for Kerkorian at one point. But Kirk was married four different times, including a third marriage to tennis player Lisa Bonder that lasted for only one month.

This marriage created immense problems for the investing legend. There were public lawsuits with damning details, a paternity controversy over a child that was not his, multiple friends jailed for wire-tapping Bonder’s phone, and tens of millions of dollars spent trying to make his problems go away.

He isn’t the only example in history.

One of the most famous situations was Monica Lewinsky and President Bill Clinton. The White House intern participated in a consensual sexual encounter with the leader of the free world and the fallout brought Clinton to the brink of ruin.

Even a pawn can take down a king.

This lesson doesn’t just apply to successful men in complicated relationships. In 2001, a relatively unknown journalist at FORTUNE named @bethanymac12 started asking a simple question: “How does Enron make money?”

This one question eventually led to the demise of Enron, once thought to be a very successful corporation, but ended up being one of the largest corporate frauds in history. It didn’t matter that no one really knew McLean. She was just doing her job and her investigation slayed a giant.

This idea is not exclusive to modern history.

Roman emperor Caligula was assassinated by members of his own Praetorian Guard, led by Cassius Chaerea. This is noteworthy because Caligula is widely credited with preparing the Roman empire for the successful conquest of Britain. It wasn’t a feuding military that took him out. It was a trusted group of bodyguards who had physical proximity.

Remember, even a pawn can take down a king.

「大空头」Burry 再度加码做空 AI，押注芯片股 2027 年前后大幅回调

「大空头」Michael Burry 于 11 月 12 日趁纳斯达克 100 指数反弹至 27,000 点附近，将看跌期权仓位翻倍，并重新建立 VanEck 半导体 ETF（SMH）看跌期权头寸，相关期权到期时间设在 2027 年初。

Burry 将纳指 100 指数 10 月 6 日创下的阶段性高点类比为 2000 年互联网泡沫顶部，认为当前 AI 热潮可能正在形成新一轮「牛市陷阱」，并预判芯片股和科技板块将在 2027 年年中前出现显著回调。

黄仁勋离职事件也成为其看空逻辑的一部分。Burry 建议投资者「离场」，认为英伟达领导层变动可能冲击公司利润率与增长前景，并进一步波及 AI 基础设施产业链，点名 CoreWeave、Nebius 和台积电可能受到连锁影响。

有意思的是，Burry 并非全面看空股票。其近期披露的持仓调整还包括增持 PayPal、MercadoLibre、Adobe、京东等个股，并重新买入 Lululemon。

一边加码做空 AI，一边增持消费、科技与其他个股，Burry 的最新布局更像是在押注 AI 估值回归，而非全面撤离美股。

kava:native fell over -42% in 24 hours after began investigating unexpected behavior from an ecosystem dApp and South Korean exchange Upbit issued a trading warning.

Kava stated that recent on-chain activity involves the bridging and sale of kava:native tokens on BSC, clarifying that the event is isolated within Kava Lend rather than an infinite mint. 

Out of caution, Kava paused cross-chain asset withdrawals via the Axelar bridge while partner exchanges suspended deposits and withdrawals pending a full incident report.

ripple:native ETF OUTFLOWS HIT 8-MONTH HIGH AS PRICE BREAKS $1

US spot ripple:native ETFs recorded $19.13M in weekly outflows, their largest in eight months, as ripple:native fell below $1.00.

Selling hit hardest early in the week, with -$10.42M exiting on Nov. 9 and -$7.62M on Nov. 10.

Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson stated during a recent YouTube AMA that he never promised cardano:native would rise or overtake $BTC, pushing back against investor criticism. 

Hoskinson said some investors were effectively asking him to drive the token's price higher, noting that Cardano has finished its original roadmap, all promised infrastructure is in place, and the network now governs itself independently.

刚刚在币安出现一笔大额ETH爆仓💥

数据显示， $ETH 在 1832.19 美元附近出现一笔 1045 万美元的大额多单清算，当前ETH价格约 1840 美元。

易理华与Justin Sun探讨为何看空纳指和比特币，AI产业链或迎来一轮降杠杆与挤泡沫

11 月 14 日，Liquid Capital 创始人易理华 @Jackyi_ld  发文表示，原本在 8.6 万美元逃顶后，一直在寻找机会抄底，但随着民主党上台和黄仁勋事件彻底打破了 AI 短期生态，近期反复思考这将在未来一年甚至二年如何影响美股，已经超越了分析比特币交易的数据框架。

昨晚曾与 Justin Sun @justinsuntron 讨论近 1 个小时，探讨他为何看空纳指和比特币，其表示，现在清仓 AI 股说不定就是以后的高点。过去几年英伟达代表的 AI 企业，因为无限看好 AI 趋势而带来的杠杆和次贷，远远超过目前 AI 收入的增长，如果龙头英伟达甚至马斯克出现问题，整个产业链会迎来一轮降杠杆和挤泡沫，美股会持续大幅度回调，如果再严重点甚至引发金融危机，永远要准备最坏的情况。

Wintermute 年花1000万美元锁定 60 毫秒数据优势，在 Hyperliquid 累计盈利超 2 亿美元

Hyperliquid 有一套叫 gossip priority（读优先）的机制,每 3 分钟拍卖一次，出价最高的地址可以优先收到即将进入的订单数据。

⏰每个席位大约能降低 20 毫秒延迟，顶级席位叠加后，能比普通用户早大约 50-60 毫秒看到订单流

Loris Tools 的链上数据显示，过去一个月里，Wintermute 关联钱包在顶级席位上的胜率约 76%。他们为了维持这个位置，日均支出大约 2.6 万美元，年化接近 1000 万美元。

出价本身对所有人开放，但要真正拿到完整的 60 毫秒优势，需要满足额外条件：

🔺直接和 Foundation 节点做直连。而直连的要求是达到一定做市量（约全网 maker 成交量的 0.5%）
🔺质押至少 1 万枚 $HYPE

像Wintermute @wintermute_t 这种顶级做市商能轻松满足，而大多数中小做市商是没有资格的。

做市商的核心工作是挂单提供流动性，同时要避免被“毒性订单”吃到。有了这 60 毫秒的提前量，Wintermute 就可以做到：

1️⃣、提前撤单
看到大单即将进来，自己的报价还没被吃到之前，先撤掉。普通做市商 60 毫秒后才看到，撤单已经来不及，报价被打掉。

2️⃣、调整报价
提前知道订单流方向，马上把报价往更有利的位置移动，或者收紧/放宽点差。

3️⃣、跨所对冲
在 Hyperliquid 上提前看到大单，立刻在 Binance 或其他交易所反向对冲，把风险转走。等普通用户在 Hyperliquid 上反应过来时，价格已经动了。

Hyperliquid 本身设计是取消单优先于吃单，本意是保护做市商。但加上这 60 毫秒的“预览”，等于让付钱的人能更安全地利用这个规则：自己先撤，别人的报价还留在盘口被吃。

🎯对小做市商来说，这就是反复被狙击。他们看不到提前量，报价总是慢一步，被吃几次后只能放宽点差，或者直接关掉山寨币的做市机器人。最后订单簿变薄、点差变大，成本落在普通交易者身上。

这套机制在华尔街早已玩的炉火纯青，纳斯达克等传统交易所会出售离自己机房撮合引擎最近的机柜位置给高频交易公司。

逻辑和这套链上的拍卖机制是一样的：离撮合引擎越近，延迟越低，位置越好越贵。

不过Hyperliuid这种做法，此前曾遭社区质疑，优先费用机制的公平性，以及是否符合美国监管要求。

tweets.text: upbit has joined bithumb and coinone in restricting kava deposits and withdrawals. the bnb chain wallet that received 49.21m kava swapped a final 849,000 kava for 27,825 usdt. kava says the activity was confined to kava lend, its lending market, which was already winding down after an october 5 vote. lend still recorded about 55.2m kava in deposits net of borrowing. that figure does not show withdrawable reserves, so recovery for lend depositors is not resolved.

strategy, the bitcoin treasury company behind mstr, cannot be forced by lenders to sell btc. all its btc was unencumbered at september 30, and its convertible debt is unsecured, with no margin-call trigger. it held $4.914b of usd assets on november 8, about 3.36 years of preferred dividends and interest. its first convertible put, $1.01b, comes in september 2027. so any btc sale is a management choice. strategy already sold 2,225 btc in july to fund preferred payouts, but no november sale is reported.

hyperliquid's protocol fees held steady week on week: $20.34m in november 7-13 against $20.38m the week before, defillama data shows. hyperliquid's assistance fund automatically turns its share of trading fees into hype, and that hype is burned. so the activity that pays for hype burns has stopped shrinking. modeled holder revenue rose 0.5% to $15.52m, but that is a model, not a count of executed buys.
